correctness.rationale: The proof imports the established constant-modulus necessity and fixes target counting normalization. Fiberwise triangle equality is forced because the sharp constant is attained by the constant phase; translated collision produces (T-1)^3(T+1)u=0 and odd orbit telescoping gives every third additive difference zero. The cyclic exponent p then forces p-torsion phases and an F_p-quadratic form. The conic triple identity reduces its trace-bilinear map to one multiplication operator; for each nonzero Frobenius exponent the rational norm-one conic witness has nonzero quadratic Taylor coefficient and degree below q-2, excluding that exponent. Chirp shifts give the converse; trace nondegeneracy makes q^2 projective classes. Exact modular fiber-rank checks reproduce q=5,7,25,49; no finite computation is used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source sharp theorem covers all prime powers but characterizes only coefficient magnitudes. A complete equality-set classification over all non-prime fields is a motivated natural missing invariant: it rules out a rapidly growing family of exotic quadratic forms on the additive vector space and leaves exactly q^2 chirps, which is a useful rigidity baseline for sharp finite-field Fourier extension and quantitative near-extremizer questions. It covers infinitely many extension fields and is not a single-parameter increment of the known prime case.
